`abstract class NodeScrollEvent<N extends Node>`<br/>
**Extends:** [`NodeEvent<N>`](/reference/events/nodeevent/)<br/>
**Known subtypes:** [`NodeScrollEvent.Pre`](/reference/events/nodescrollevent-pre/), [`NodeScrollEvent.Post`](/reference/events/nodescrollevent-post/)<br/>
**Package:** `dev.joid.lib.ui.event.impl.node` · **Module:** `core` · **Source:** [NodeScrollEvent.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/core/src/main/java/dev/joid/lib/ui/event/impl/node/NodeScrollEvent.java)

A change of the scroll of a node on one axis, with the offset before and after, in a cancellable `Pre` and a `Post`.

## Description

[`Node.beforeScroll`](/reference/nodes/node/#Node-method-beforeScroll) receives a [`NodeScrollEvent.Pre`](/reference/events/nodescrollevent-pre/) and can refuse the scroll; [`Node.onScroll`](/reference/nodes/node/#Node-event-onScroll), [`Node.onScrollToEnd`](/reference/nodes/node/#Node-event-onScrollToEnd) and [`Node.onScrollEndReached`](/reference/nodes/node/#Node-event-onScrollEndReached) receive a [`NodeScrollEvent.Post`](/reference/events/nodescrollevent-post/).

| `double` | [getOffset](#NodeScrollEvent-method-getOffset)() | Returns the offset after the change, in design pixels: `0D` at the start of the content, down to minus the scrollable length at its end. |

### getAxis

<a id="NodeScrollEvent-method-getOffset"></a>

### getOffset

`double getOffset()` 

Returns the offset after the change, in design pixels: `0D` at the start of the content, down to minus the scrollable length at its end.
At `onScrollEndReached`, the offset that the content reached.

### getPrevious
